title: Input schema for MAP Violations Monitor

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Retailer product or listing pages to monitor (e.g., product detail URLs, search/listing URLs)

mapTableKvKey.title: MAP table KVS key
mapTableKvKey.description: KVS key containing MAP info: JSON { "PRODUCTID|SKU": MAP, ... }

priceSelectors.title: Price selectors
priceSelectors.description: CSS selectors for price, productId (SKU), and name/title (tune to each site)

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: POST MAP violations as alerts (send product, retailer, price, MAP, URL, screenshotKey)
